description: Run the forged cubicle.script over the real tape with the reference runner, cubicle-script, net of 8 bps a round trip (the last week by default): how many trades it took, the R, and a comparison with a random null. Call it after a forge when the trader wants to know whether the rule actually fires. A rehearsal is evidence about the past, never a forecast.

market.description: the market to walk, defaults to the one the trader named (another market forges the script again for it)

name: rehearse
